clips.title: The story
paras: Bruegal Ironknuckle prowls the riot-torn halls of the Stormwind Stockade. The dangerous dwarf is a powerful brawler, and anyone trying to restore order may meet his fists.

Bruegal Ironknuckle roams the Stormwind Stockade during its open revolt. The dangerous dwarf is known for his brutal brawling strength. Many of the city's most volatile cutthroats have seized the underground cellblocks, and Bruegal is among them. He does not stay in one cell, but prowls the riot-torn halls, ready to bash anyone trying to quell the uprising.

Bruegal Ironknuckle is one of many rogues and outlaws held deep beneath Stormwind. The Defias Brotherhood and its ringleaders direct much of the revolt, while inmates like Bruegal show that the prison holds criminals from across the eastern realms. Whatever crimes brought him there, his fierce resilience makes him elusive and one of the deadliest lone inmates in the corridors.
